app.title: go-vless-dashboard
app.subtitle: TanStack Router (file-based) + shadcn (Base UI) + Cloudflare Worker (Hono /api) is ready.

multiSession.manageAccountsDescription: Manage your accounts for secure access.

deleteUser.deleteAccountDescription: Permanently remove your account and all associated data. This cannot be undone.
deleteUser.deleteUserVerificationSent: Check your email to confirm account deletion.

home.cardDesc: The home loader requests same-origin /api/health, served by Hono inside the Worker.
home.apiError: Worker API connection failed. Make sure the dev server / deployment is running.

about.title: About
about.body: This is a sample second-level route. Delete it or turn it into a dashboard page.

notify.desc: One notification channel at a time; saving switches (the old one is dropped).
notify.noChannel: No enabled channel, pick one before testing
notify.feishuDesc: Add a custom bot to a group chat, paste the webhook URL; add the secret too if signing is on.
notify.telegramDesc: Get a bot token from @BotFather, then fill in the chat id (user/group/channel).
notify.secretPlaceholder: Only if the bot requires signing

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.desc: Manage go-vless servers. Keys stay on the Worker side.
nodes.name: Name
nodes.deleteNodesDesc: Linked user scopes and traffic records will be removed as well. This cannot be undone.
nodes.updateSelectedDesc: Selected online nodes will update to the latest version, download, replace and restart with brief downtime. Offline nodes are skipped and can be updated individually later.
nodes.emptyDesc: Add your first go-vless server to manage it.
nodes.formDesc: The backend is probed live to verify URL and key before saving.
nodes.formDescAdd: Just a name for now. A management key is generated automatically; add the server URL in Edit (auto-filled once the backend registers), connectivity is verified once complete.
nodes.confirmDeleteDesc: Removes the management record of “{{name}}” (remote server keeps running).
nodes.installCmdCopied: Install command copied, run it on your server
nodes.subNoUsers: No node users yet — create one in user management first
nodes.nodeUsersDesc: Subscription users for your nodes: each token is used as the uuid in subscription links, auto-pushed to your nodes on add/remove; offline nodes sync on next register.
nodes.nodeUserNoNodes: No pushable nodes, will sync on next register
nodes.nodeUserDeleteDesc: “{{name}}” will be removed and its subscription links stop working.
nodes.scopeHint: Leave empty for all nodes (including future ones)
nodes.userSubDesc: One URL for everything: auto-detects by client, falls back to Clash
nodes.userSubUrlHint: Advanced: ?format=vless|base64|clash forces a format, ?port= and ?security=tls|none override the 443/tls defaults
nodes.tlsExpiring: Expiring within 30 days, check port 80 and renewal
nodes.tlsNoCert: No certificate yet (waiting for first handshake)
nodes.updateHint: Empty for latest; skips if already on target. Download takes a while — acceptance is immediate, check backend logs and version for result.
nodes.updateAllDesc: All online nodes will update to the latest version, download, replace and restart with brief downtime. Offline nodes are skipped and can be updated individually later.

traffic.desc: Periodic snapshots of backend user traffic (newest first).
traffic.filterDesc: Filter by node, node user and time range; changing filters resets to the first page.
